gloss: hair whorl (on the crown of the head)

definitions.gloss: hair whorl; crown of the head
definitions.explanation: The spiral point on the top of the head from which the hair grows outward. Also written {旋毛|つむじ}.

examples.japanese: つむじ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧つむじ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あたり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}く→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。
examples.english: My father's hair is getting thin around the crown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頼|たの}み→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}かった→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧つむじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げて→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦くれ→くれる：00724_kureru⟧なくなった。
examples.english: Maybe I asked the wrong way: he got in a huff and stopped helping.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- つむじ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げる→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧: to get in a huff, to turn contrary
- つむじ{曲|ま}がり: a contrary, awkward person
- つむじ{風|かぜ}: a whirlwind (wind that spirals like a whorl)
